title: Servers apply /set update PatchObject as RFC 7396 merge, ignoring path keys
description: crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:~1084 ContactCard/set update (and other servers' update_object) use json_merge_patch, so a key like 'name/full' or 'addressBookIds/ab2' is stored as a literal top-level key instead of applied as an RFC 8620 5.3 path. AGENTS.md now says extension servers must use jmap-server::helpers::apply_jmap_patch. Sweep all servers' update paths.
notes: contacts memory.rs update_object now uses apply_patch_object (invalidPatch on error, storage unchanged); addressBookIds validator requires every value true (RFC 9610 §3). Until then address_book_set_destroy_cascade_patches_shared_card and ..._mixed_exclusive_and_shared fail.
